checks.name: Mobile dashboard module navigation reaches Products workspace
checks.evidence: At 390px, the in-page Stock module linked to the Products workspace and reached that route without the hidden Sidebar/Header chrome.

checks.name: Compact account popover opens and closes accessibly
checks.evidence: Account popover opens, exposes aria-expanded, and closes on Escape and an outside click.

checks.name: Sidebar keeps the active settings destination reachable
checks.evidence: The active Setup group expands on direct navigation and remains expanded when the route changes back to a settings child page.

checks.name: Legacy classification route opens the read-only category workspace
checks.evidence: The legacy classification route opened the 390px Manage Categories dialog; Escape closed it and removed the query without category writes.

checks.name: Product search filters the Odoo catalogue
checks.evidence: Odoo has no R2 product fixture; a product fixture is required for search validation.

checks.name: Product edit dialog is prefilled from Odoo
checks.evidence: Odoo has no R2 product fixture; a product fixture is required for edit validation.

checks.name: New product form blocks submission without a name
checks.evidence: Odoo product workspace controls were not enabled after loading; a product fixture or session warmup is required.

checks.name: CSV product import previews valid rows without writing to Odoo
checks.evidence: Odoo product data was still loading, so the CSV import control remained disabled.

checks.name: Customer creation form is required-field guarded
checks.evidence: At 390px the customer dialog fit the viewport; initial focus, trigger restoration, required Customer name and empty-form protection passed.

checks.name: Customer mobile card and edit dialog render from a read-only fixture
checks.evidence: Mobile customer card showed Odoo fixture details and tap-to-call; edit dialog fit the viewport and was closed without saving.

checks.name: Sales history searches and opens a refunded receipt
checks.evidence: At 390px the Refunded filter returned a mobile receipt card; the receipt dialog opened by keyboard, fit the viewport, and hid the duplicate full-refund action.

checks.name: Replenishment coverage control refreshes the estimate
checks.evidence: At 390px, replenishment showed product cards without overflow (390px); coverage changed to 7 days; no-sales state remains explicitly qualified.

checks.name: Reports period controls refresh the Orithos dashboard
checks.evidence: At 390px there is no horizontal overflow (390px); the 24-hour Orithos report has no sales, so the qualified empty state renders, and the AI assistant opens/closes.

checks.name: Legacy sales report opens the live reporting dashboard
checks.evidence: The legacy sales report route redirected to the live Reports dashboard; its period controls rendered without horizontal overflow at 390px.
